explication: EeveeSpotify is an iOS Spotify tweak that modifies Spotify behavior to enable Premium-like features and adds configurable custom lyrics. The main documented flow intercepts Spotify user-data requests, deserializes and changes parameters, then returns the modified result; lyrics are fetched from a selected provider and converted into Spotify lyric data for the Now Playing experience. The tree also shows settings, experiments, and an embedded XML codec. Some provider selection and hook wiring were not shown, so those connections are omitted or marked unverified.
